# Skill catalog

Every skill, command, and agent in a released plugin: 10 skills, 9 commands, and 1 agents across 1 plugins.

Skills activate on their own. Claude reads each skill's `description` and loads the skill when
your request matches it, so you don't call a skill by name. The **Trigger phrases** column is
taken from that description: phrase a request along those lines, or start from the
**Example prompt**. Commands and agents are invoked differently; see the short list under each plugin.

Each example prompt was run in Claude Code with these plugins installed. Where it didn't load the
skill, the row says so: the skill still works when Claude loads it, but its description needs
work before it triggers reliably. Mentioning the skill by name ("use the ux-writing skill to ...") works in the meantime.

To report a problem with a skill, open an issue and mention its maintainer.

## Tiers

| Tier | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| Core | Maintained by SSEC and useful across research software projects in any field. Held to the full release, CI, and security standards. |
| Community | Built for a specific scientific field or tool ecosystem, or contributed from outside SSEC. Reviewed on entry and must pass CI. Domain plugins were folded into this tier (see #136). |

**Commands.** Type the command in Claude Code, with any arguments after it. The short form without the plugin prefix also works when no other command has that name.

- [`/ai-research-workflows:experiment`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/experiment.md): Experiment with different approaches before committing to implementation
- [`/ai-research-workflows:handoff`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/handoff.md): Create a handoff document to transfer work context to another session
- [`/ai-research-workflows:harden`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/harden.md): Make research/scientific code robust with correctness, regression, and stability checks
- [`/ai-research-workflows:implement`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/implement.md): Implement changes based on an approved plan, tracking progress phase by phase
- [`/ai-research-workflows:iterate-plan`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/iterate-plan.md): Update an existing implementation plan based on feedback
- [`/ai-research-workflows:plan`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/plan.md): Create a detailed implementation plan through interactive research and iteration
- [`/ai-research-workflows:reproduce`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/reproduce.md): Capture environment, data, seeds, and config so a result can be reproduced
- [`/ai-research-workflows:research`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/research.md): Research the codebase and/or external prior art to build context for a task
- [`/ai-research-workflows:validate`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/commands/validate.md): Validate that an implementation was correctly executed against its plan

**Agents.** Claude delegates to an agent when the task fits; to choose one yourself, ask for it by name (for example, "use the research-workflow-orchestrator agent to ...").

- [`research-workflow-orchestrator`](../plugins/ai-research-workflows/agents/research-workflow-orchestrator.md): Guides users through structured AI-enabled research workflows for software development.
